question: Regarding the export of commodities from India in 2021, which commodity ranks first?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Engineering goods.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Regarding the export of commodities from India in 2021, Engineering goods rank first.**
 
• **India's Engineering Exports scenario:**
 
 
• **Fiscal 2018-19** was another remarkable year for the engineering exporting community as Indian engineering exports reached their lifetime high in two consecutive fiscals despite having a number of impediments to growth.
 
• Indian engineering exports stood at** US$ 81.02 billion during 2018-19 surpassing the previous record high of US$ 76.2 billion in fiscal 2017-18.**
 
• On a cumulative basis for the entire fiscal 2018-19, **engineering export recorded 6.32 percent growth over the previous fiscal while its share in total merchandise exports was 24.5 percent.**
 
• **During 2018-19, 16 out of the top 25 countries** recorded positive growth in engineering exports from India over the same period last year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India’s merchandise export** in April -September 2022-23 was USD 229.05 billion with an increase of 15.54% over USD 198.25 billion in April -September 2021-22.
 
• **Value of non-petroleum exports **in September 2022 was 26.54 USD billion, registering a negative growth of only 7.25% over non-petroleum exports of USD 28.62 billion in September 2021.
 
• **Value of non-oil, non-GJ (gold, silver & Precious metals) imports** was USD 36.5 billion in September 2022 with a positive growth of 16.78%over non-oil and non-GJ imports of USD 31.26 billion in September 2021.
